name: Debrah Goetz
reason: A medical intuitive (Vero Beach, Florida) whose brand, Shift profile and certification programme are all medical intuition; her membership is sold on "quantum surgeries", "organ overhauls" and the body "fully repairing", her free 21-day challenge on headaches, anxiety and pain, and her bundle could not be opened (Kajabi blocks it), so only about ten of her YouTube videos (soul contracts, ancestral clearing, self-abandonment) pass the health-claim rule; her only Shift course has no title or page yet. Photos (YouTube 23.4K subscribers) are usable if a human wants to revisit.
